summaries.title: Towards Language Models That Can See: Computer Vision Through the LENS of Natural Language
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于实证与机理剖析。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Towards Language Models That Can See** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）。核心论点主张：We propose LENS, a modular approach for tackling computer vision problems by leveraging the power of large language models (LLMs)。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We evaluate the approach on pure computer vision settings such as zero- and few-shot object recognition, as well as on vision and language problems。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（LENS can be applied to any off-the-shelf LLM and we find that the LLMs with LENS perform highly competitively with much bigger and much more sophisticated systems, without any...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 29 赞），本工作修正了对 **多模态与统一基座** 的经验性直觉假设，为后续算法改进指明了真正起作用的因果关键点；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。
